subject: E-2185: TLS handshake failed on Android
body:
Hi, I'm using LedgerLine 9.1.8 on Android 15 (Pixel 8). Starting yesterday, the moment I open the
app a dialog reads "E-2185: TLS handshake failed".

The security team switched on TLS inspection at the proxy. The latest release notes talk about
corporate root certificate support.

Before writing in I tried searching the help centre; same error afterwards.

Thanks, Ivan Petrov (Brightwater Clinics)
